# Colorlib

> Colorlib is a comprehensive resource for free WordPress themes, responsive website templates, and web design tools built on Bootstrap and HTML.

Colorlib provides designers and developers with a curated collection of high-quality, free WordPress themes and templates. The platform focuses on responsive design, customization tools, and modern web design resources to help users build professional websites quickly and efficiently.

## Key Topics

- WordPress themes
- Website templates
- Bootstrap templates
- HTML templates
- Responsive design
- Free themes
- Theme customization
- Web design resources
- Shapely theme
- Illdy theme
- Activello theme
- Sparkling theme
- Dazzling theme
- Travelify theme
- Theme Customizer
